*If its horn is currently broken, when the zone becomes engaged in a campaign battle, it will run away.

*Checks as '''Impossible to Gauge'''.

Auroral Alicorn is known to use the following abilities:
*Uses [[Scintillant Lance]] which deals 1000-1200 [[Light|light-based]] [[Cone Attack]].
*Uses [[Grace of Hera]] that grants [[Regen]] and removes harmful status effects from everyone in the vicinity.
*Uses [[Acheron Kick]] which deals 300~ damage AoE [[Knockback]].
*Uses [[Rampant Stance]] which rears up and damages targets with the possibility of inflicting [[Weight]], [[Stun]], and [[Aspir]].

===Maruna-Kurina's Notes===
Current taxonomy teaches us that at presentaru, the monoceros family contains few known specimens. Those that are classified exhibit great horn spire-wires jutting from their majestic heads, and are either born of light, or of darkness.
An influx of eyewitness accounts in recent days all point to the undeniable existence of the beastaru named Dark Ixion. Tempered like a storm and ever wary, both allies and beastman alike tend to keep their distance.
The other is dubbed Auroral Alicorn and exhibits a brilliantaru shade of white and a calm, gentle demeanor. The two couldn't be more dissimilar-wimilar.
Though almost never seen in the wild prior to the war, Auroral Alicorn has recently been sighted in Jugner Forest, some say nursing wounds. 

=== How to Influence ===
*Alicorn has a passive DoT when its horn is broken. It cannot be dispelled, but he can be cured to regain his HP. The message "The creature whinnies contentedly." appears when cured.
*Noticed the whinnies contently message appears on first cure if you zone (i.e. [[Recall-Jugner]]) between cures. Can still say message again after some repeated curing.
| historicalbackground = 
}}

=== When Allied ===
*When allied with the Federal Forces of Windurst, Auroral Alicorn can be found at the corner of (G-9) and (H-10) in the northern section of [[Windurst Waters (S)]].
*When allied with the Republican Army of Bastok, Auroral Alicorn can be found in [[Grauberg (S)]], [[North Gustaberg (S)]].
*When allied with the Royal Army of San d'Oria, Auroral Alicorn can be found in [[East Ronfaure (S)]], [[Vunkerl Inlet (S)]] or [[Jugner Forest (S)]].

[[Category:Monoceros]]

==Historical Background==
''Alicorn'' is simply another word for the spiral horn of a unicorn. ''Auroral'' is an adjective referring to the dawn or the aurorae; both being phenomena that are associated with light.  The Auroral Alicorn, therefore, is meant to stand in contrast with Dark Ixion.

:*"''Nothing Actually.''"
:*"''I'd like to get out of the city.''": Just got here and you're aching to leave, eh? Listen, the lands are wild beyond our gates, filled with fiends and their ilk. But if you must go, take those stairs, head for Northern San d'Oria, then go out Ranperre Gate. You'll need to go down Laborman's Way, then take a right to get to the gate. If you need any help with directions, ask those around you. Our citizens are friendly, for the most part.
:*"''I'd like to do some shopping.''": If you want to buy weapons or other supplies, just ask one of the merchants in town.
:*"''Tell me more about adventuring.''": Ahhh, recruits... Don't know which way to hold a sword and you think you're ready for adventures. Well, what would you like to know?
::*"''Helping people.''": Ah, a commendable choice! Come to think of it, there was a lady in front of a house on Pikeman's Way. She may be in need of assistance. If you need any help with directions, ask those around you. Our citizens are friendly, for the most part.
::*"''Hunting monsters.''": Ahhh, recruits... Don't know your own limits until a fiend beats it into your head for you. Very well. How about gathering some hides? From Northern San d'Oria, pass through Victory Arch to enter Sounthern San d'Oria. There you'll find the Tanners' Guild. They need hides every now and then. If you have trouble finding the Tanners' Guild, just ask around.
::*"''Making easy money.''": Easy money, eh? Typical of a new recruit. I canot promise ease, but try the lumberyard in Northern San d'Oria. Should be enough work for you there. Go up those stairs there to get to Northern San d'Oria. You'll find the lumberyard near the top. If you need any help with directions, ask those around you. Our citizens are friendly, for the most part.
::*"''Working for my country.''": Ah, a commendable choice. Head to any city gate and inquire at the gatehouse. They'll give you work befitting your rank. If you need any help with directions, ask those around you. Our citizens are friendly, for the most part.

===Notes===
*Assisted by either [[Abenzio]], [[Bryher]], [[Camlin]] or [[Darach]].
:*Assisted by [[Bryher]] ([[:Category:Morbols|Morbol]]) in [[Bastok]]-controlled regions.
:*Assisted by [[Camlin]] ([[:Category:Sabotenders|Sabotender]]) in [[Windurst]]-controlled regions.
:*Assisted by [[Darach]] ([[:Category:Treants|Treant]]) in [[San d'Oria]]-controlled regions.
:*[[Abenzio]] ([[:Category:Goobbues|Goobbue]]) may assist Babban Ny Mheillea in [[Windurst Waters (S)]], [[Southern San d'Oria (S)]], and [[Bastok Markets (S)]].
:*Will be assisted by [[Abenzio]], [[Bryher]], [[Camlin]] and [[Darach]] if attacking [[Xarcabard (S)]] or [[Beaucedine Glacier (S)]]
*Battle Cry: ''The flower atop Babban Ny Mheillea's head appears to be in full bloom!''
*Uses [[Petal Pirouette]].
===Maruna-Kurina's Notes===
Unprecedented in history-wistory, there has recently been an affable plantoid befriending soldiers on the battlefield. It most closely resembles one of those mandragora known to inhabitaru the wilds to the west.
Is that a shred of doubt I sense!? I've seen it with my own eyes, I tell you! This is no figment of the imagination or some delusional soldier's hallucination! Still don't believe me?
Head on over to the Meriphataud Mountains and try trading a [[Distilled Water|flask of distilled water]] or some fertilizer to the odd little treeman you find. He just might be moved to come and help you out in a fightaru!
Regardless, I wonder what it is he could possibly be doing here... N-n-not that I am about to startaru stalking him to find out or anything!

===How to Influence===
Trade [[Distilled Water]] to Sprout located in middle of J-7, J-9 or F-6.

==Historical Background==
On the Isle of Man, a ''babban ny mheillea'' is a traditional cornhusk doll made from the last sheaf cut during the harvest. The term is a Manx expression meaning "harvest baby."
